items.criterion: Stage one of the brief writes a record and issues an opaque resume token.
items.judgment: Read the brief back through its token and confirm the stage and the contact.

items.criterion: Submitting the brief books the held slot and names the time in both zones.
items.judgment: Read the booking from the submit response.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous submissions for one slot yield exactly one booking.
items.judgment: Fire both behind a barrier and count the successes.

items.criterion: A contested slot carries exactly one booking row.
items.judgment: Count booking rows for the contested slot.

items.criterion: A refused booking leaves every other answer in the brief intact.
items.judgment: Read the brief back after the refusal.

items.criterion: A brief attachment exists in the bucket at its pinned key.
items.judgment: List the object store under the brief prefix.

items.criterion: No attachment row holds the uploaded bytes.
items.judgment: Read the attachment rows and inspect their columns.

items.criterion: An unpublished case is not found at its own route for a signed-out visitor.
items.judgment: Request the case over the API and at its route.

items.criterion: An unpublished case stays hidden from a signed-in client.
items.judgment: Request the case with a client session.

items.criterion: A client cannot read an engagement their account is not attached to.
items.judgment: Request the other engagement with the second client's session.

items.criterion: An account carrying no approval right cannot approve.
items.judgment: Post an approval with the non-approving client.

items.criterion: A refused approval writes no record and leaves the version open.
items.judgment: Count approval rows before and after.

items.criterion: Approving appends a record naming the actor and the moment.
items.judgment: Count approval rows and read the latest.

items.criterion: An approved version freezes and the earlier version stays readable.
items.judgment: Read the version and the engagement back.

items.criterion: Every facet count equals the number of cases that value leaves.
items.judgment: Compare the facet counts against the case listing.

items.criterion: Composing a deck returns an opaque token and the required typed blocks.
items.judgment: Read the composed deck back through its token.

items.criterion: An expired deck link and a revoked one answer identically.
items.judgment: Compare the two responses.

items.criterion: An oversized attachment is refused alone and the brief survives.
items.judgment: Attach past the limit and read the brief back.

items.criterion: An invalid enquiry is refused and stores nothing.
items.judgment: Count brief rows before and after.

items.criterion: Every seeded account signs in with the corpus password.
items.judgment: Log in as each seeded account.

items.criterion: Nothing the browser downloads carries a credential.
items.judgment: Scan the served documents for credential markers.

items.criterion: The resume token is unguessable and carries no address.
items.judgment: Inspect the issued token and the resume route headers.

items.criterion: The health route answers once the app is ready.
items.judgment: Request the health route.

items.criterion: Every seeded row appears exactly once.
items.judgment: Count the seeded accounts and the case slugs.

items.criterion: The portal listing returns only engagements the account is joined to.
items.judgment: Compare the listing against the engagement count.

items.criterion: An attachment that has not been scanned is readable by nobody.
items.judgment: Request each unscanned object key.
